rootCause.summary:
LangExtract's QAPromptGenerator flattens prompt_description + all few-shot ExampleData into one literal 'Examples
Q: ...
A: {...}

Q: <target>
A: ' user message with a generic system prompt. ornith-1.5-9b deterministically returns {"extractions": []} for that shape regardless of schema, example quality, or token budget.
rootCause.isolationMethod: Monkeypatched OpenAILanguageModel._process_single_prompt in-process inside the live miniforge-nlp-sidecar container to print the actual outgoing api_params and raw completion text; compared against a hand-built real multi-turn request (system + per-example user/assistant + final user) against the same endpoint/schema/seed/temperature, which succeeded.

bugsFixedAlongTheWay.detail: provider_kwargs['max_tokens'] was silently ignored; OpenAILanguageModel._build_chat_completions_params() reads config['max_output_tokens']. Renamed at both call sites.
POST /extract/documentation-facts 500'd with NameError: name 'json' is not defined at response construction (json.dumps inside outputHash). Added 'import json'.
_native_grounded_extractions() was missing 'from langextract.providers.schemas.openai import OpenAISchema' (present in its sibling _native_documentation_facts()), causing a live NameError. Restored.

fix.mechanism: _ensure_grounded_provider_controls()'s existing build_params patch now also rebuilds real multi-turn `messages` when a module-global _grounded_extraction_context is set (_set_grounded_extraction_context/_clear_grounded_extraction_context, single-flight, matching this module's existing global-state convention at max_workers=1). _restructure_as_multiturn() deterministically recovers the target question from LangExtract's own flattened prompt text and falls back to the original flattened prompt (returns None) if it can't -- never guesses.
fix.sharedBlastRadius: Affects both the pre-existing CONCEPT extraction path (_native_grounded_extractions, used beyond this proposal) and the new DocumentationFactV1 path (_native_documentation_facts) -- flagged before implementing per operator instruction to proceed.

conceptPath.input: This module uses PostgreSQL for persistence and Redis for caching.

documentationFactPath.input: CUDA Tile IR requires sm_86 or later architecture. Tile IR is deprecated on Kepler-generation GPUs.
PyTorch 2.13 removed CUDA 12.8 support. The Redis client requires TLS in production. Batch size must not exceed 128 on 8GB GPUs.
documentationFactPath.note: Novel fixture not used during debugging -- confirms the fix is not overfit to the one debug fixture.

retraction.claim: An earlier note in this same investigation session claimed CONCEPT extraction was also currently broken (metadata.grounded_extraction_used=false / structure.concepts=[]).
retraction.correction: structure.concepts is populated by an unrelated code path (_code_concepts()/entity-text list in miniforge_nlp_sidecar.py ~line 2370), never by LangExtract's grounded output. Grounded results were always in metadata.grounded_extractions, which was not checked in that pass. This was a testing mistake, not a real regression.

doc12OpenWork: apiRules was empty in every test above because no fixture used was API-symbol-shaped (function signature / parameter constraint text). The multi-turn fix applies to the same extraction machinery DOC-12 uses, but DOC-12's own non-empty-output proof is unverified, not assumed.
